book.name: Annabi Hose
book.title: Ala xa masenyi Annabi Hose bɛ Ala xa masenyi Annabi Hose bɛ

content.text: «Wo xa gere sara fe!
Yaxui goroma nɛ Alatala xa banxi ma alɔ sɛgɛ,
barima ɲama bara n ma laayidi kana,
e naxa muruta n ma sɛriyɛ ma.
E n xilima,
‹Muxu Marigi Ala, muxu i kolon, muxu tan, Isirayila.›
Isirayila to bara fe fanyi bɛɲin,
yaxui birama nɛ a fɔxɔ ra.
E bara mangɛe ti n ma yaamari mu naxan na,
e bara kuntigie ti e mu n maxɔrin.
E bara kuyee rafala e xa gbeti nun xɛɛma ra.
Nee halakima na nan ma.
Samarikae, wo wo xa ninge kuye wɔlɛ.
N bara xɔnɔ wo ma a ɲaaxi ra.
Wo wo yɛtɛ manɔxɔma yi fe mɔɔli ra han mun tɛmui?
Yi kuye fatanxi wo tan Isirayila nan na.
Mixi nde nan a rafalaxi, Ala mu a ra!
Samari xa ninge kuye fama nɛ butuxunde.
Naxan ɲɛrɛma fe ɲaaxi kui,
gbaloe fama nɛ a lide.
Hali mɛngi tɔnsɔɛ keren, e mu a sɔtɔma xɛ ma.
Sansi naxan bulama, a mu findima baloe ra.
Hali nde findi a ra, si gbɛtɛ nan a donma.
E bara Isirayila xun nakana,
e e xanin ɲamanɛ konyiya kui.
Isirayilakae bara siga Asiriya bɔxi ma,
alɔ sofale naxan luma a keren.
Hali e mixi naxee saraxi sie tagi e kantafe ma,
n e birin malanma nɛ,
alako e xa tɔɔrɔ mangɛe xa kote bun ma.
Efirami bara sɛrɛxɛbadee rawuya
alako e xa yunubie xa xafari,
kɔnɔ na sɛrɛxɛbadee bara a niya
e xa yunubie sɔtɔ.
N bara n ma sɛriyɛe birin sɛbɛ, e xa na kolon,
kɔnɔ e mu tide toxi a ma.
E sɛrɛxɛe bama n bɛ, e na sube don,
kɔnɔ na mu rafan Alatala ma.
Yakɔsi, Alatala fama nɛ e ɲaxankatade e xa yunubie xa fe ra,
e xa gbilen Misira bɔxi ma.
Isirayila bara nɛɛmu Ala ma, naxan e daaxi.
E na mangɛ banxie tife.
Yudaya fan na taae tife, naxee sɛnbɛ gbo,
kɔnɔ n na birin ganma nɛ tɛ ra.»
